{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Modules

|eff= local

|descr= Make a list of units use any *chat command ([[groupChat]], [[vehicleChat]], [[sideChat]], [[commandChat]], [[globalChat]]).

|s1= [logic, units, isActivated] call [[BIS_fnc_moduleChat]]

|p1= logic: [[Object]] the logic. Possible [[setVariable]] parameters:
* "Text": [[String]] - the text to be sent
* "Channel": [[String]] - (Optional, default "0") a number '''as a string''':
** "0": [[groupChat]]
** "1": [[vehicleChat]]
** "2": [[sideChat]]
** "3": [[commandChat]]
** "4": [[globalChat]]

|p2= units: [[Array]] of [[Object]]s - list of chatting units

|p3= isActivated: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]]) if [[true]], the module is activated and chat is send. [[false]] disables the module

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] when done, even if ''isActivated'' equals [[false]]

|x1= <sqf>myLogic setVariable ["Channel", "2"];
myLogic setVariable ["Text", "Hello everyone, this is side chat!"];
[myLogic, [player], true] call BIS_fnc_moduleChat;</sqf>

|seealso= [[groupChat]] [[vehicleChat]] [[sideChat]] [[commandChat]] [[globalChat]] [[systemChat]]
}}
